description: This file defines classes and functions for managing CUDA streams and events in PyTorch, including wrappers for stream synchronization, event recording, and external stream handling.

classes.name: Stream
classes.description: Wrapper around a CUDA stream, supporting synchronization, event recording, and comparison.

classes.name: ExternalStream
classes.description: Wrapper around an externally allocated CUDA stream, used for interoperability.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Wrapper around a CUDA event for synchronization, timing, and IPC.

methods.name: wait_event
methods.description: Make the stream wait for a specified CUDA event.

methods.name: record_event
methods.description: Record an event on the stream.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Check if all work in the stream or event has completed.

methods.name: synchronize
methods.description: Wait for all kernels in the stream or event to complete.

methods.name: elapsed_time
methods.description: Return time elapsed between two events.

methods.name: ipc_handle
methods.description: Return an IPC handle for the event.

methods.name: from_ipc_handle
methods.description: Reconstruct an event from an IPC handle.
